summary: The customer called to inquire about an unexpectedly high recent bill. The agent verified the account, identified an accidental automatic activation of a trial internet package, and resolved the issue by canceling the extra subscription and applying a credit to the next bill. The call ended politely.

evidence.text: أنا راح ألغي الاشتراك الإضافي وأخصم المبلغ من فاتورتك القادمة فوراً.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Cancel the extra subscription and deduct the amount from the next bill.

evidence.text: مرحلاً معك سارة من خدمة العملاء، كيف أقدر أساعدك اليوم؟

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was extremely polite, professional, and maintained a helpful tone throughout the call.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent apologized for the inconvenience and acknowledged the customer's frustration appropriately.
